metadata.title: [FEATURE][BUG][UI]: Add a "View Public" checkbox in Virtual Servers page
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
Closes #3274
Closes #3276

---

## 📝 Summary

Fixes inconsistent team filtering in the Edit Server modal tools selector and adds a "View Public" checkbox that lets users include public items when building team-scoped virtual servers.

**Changes:**

- Fixed missing `team_id` parameter in Edit Server tools selector
- Added "View Public" checkbox to Add Server and Edit Server modals
- Implemented toggle logic to include/exclude `team_id` from HTMX selector URLs
- Added auto-enable feature when editing servers with public associations
- Updated search functions to respect View Public state

---

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Feature / Enhancement

| -------------- | --------------- | ------ |
| Lint suite     | `make lint`     |    pass    |
| Unit tests     | `make test`     |    pass    |

## 📓 Notes

### Test Matrix

1. **Add Server (team context, View Public unchecked):** Only team gateways/tools/resources/prompts shown
2. **Add Server (team context, View Public checked):** Team + public items shown; select public tools; uncheck; verify pills persist
3. **Edit Server (team context, no public associations):** View Public unchecked by default; only team items shown
4. **Edit Server (team context, has public associations):** View Public auto-checks; all items visible and checked
5. **Add/Edit Server (All Teams):** View Public checkbox not visible; all items shown by default
6. **Search in selectors:** Search respects View Public state in both add and edit modals

commits.message:
fix(ui): add missing team_id param to edit server tools selector

The Edit Server modal's tools selector was missing the team_id
parameter in its hx-get URL, causing it to show all tools instead of
only the team's tools when editing a team-scoped server.

Closes #3276

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
feat(ui): add View Public checkbox to Virtual Servers page

Add a "View Public" checkbox to both Add Server and Edit Server modals
that lets users include public items alongside their team's items when
building team-scoped virtual servers.

- toggleViewPublic() modifies HTMX selector URLs to include/exclude
  team_id, using onchange assignment to prevent listener accumulation
- Auto-enable logic detects when editing servers with public
  associations not visible in team-filtered selectors
- Six server-side search functions updated to respect checkbox state
- Checkbox hidden in "All Teams" context (no team_id in URL)
- Tests: 13 unit tests for toggleViewPublic (URL mutation, HTMX
  side-effects, early-return guards) plus regression test for
  listener accumulation

Closes #3274

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
test(ui): add View Public search integration tests

Add 12 tests verifying that all six server-side search functions
(tools, prompts, resources for both Add and Edit Server modals)
correctly respect the View Public checkbox state:

- team_id included in search URL when checkbox is unchecked
- team_id omitted from search URL when checkbox is checked

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix(ui): preserve gateway filter and team scope across reload paths

- toggleViewPublic: inject current gateway_id selection into hx-get
  URLs so toggling View Public does not drop the active gateway filter
- reloadAssociatedItems: include team_id in tool/resource/prompt URLs
  when View Public is unchecked, so gateway changes respect team scope
- Gateway "Select All": omit team_id from /gateways/ids request when
  View Public is checked, so all visible gateways are selected
- Tests: 3 new tests for gateway_id preservation in toggleViewPublic

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
fix(ui): use correct View Public checkbox in edit-modal Select All

initGatewaySelect's Select All handler used a hardcoded fallback
(add-server-view-public || edit-server-view-public) which always
resolved to the add-modal checkbox even when the edit modal was active.

Use the selectId parameter to pick the correct checkbox for the
active modal context.

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
